Smart India Hackathon · Team of 6

AI-Powered Automatic Block Planning to Maximize Asset Availability for Train Operations on Indian Railways

Developed as part of a six-member team for the Smart India Hackathon. The project aims to automate railway maintenance block planning using AI and data-driven analysis.
